autobuilder.help.dump.detail: While chopping, mining, ore hunting or excavating, when the inventory is nearly full it walks back to a dump chest and stores what it gathered this time; it does the same when the whole job is done. What you had when it started, tools, food, buckets and torches stay with you, plus a stack of scaffold blocks. If every dump chest is full it goes back to dropping junk. Without coordinates it uses the chest you're looking at
autobuilder.msg.material_unknown: %s supply chests haven't been opened yet, so their contents are unknown (open one once and it's remembered)

autobuilder.help.intro: /ab is short for /autobuild. Click a command to put it in chat; hover for details
autobuilder.help.click: Click to put it in chat
autobuilder.help.keys: Keys: B main screen  N start/pause  H hide preview  [ ] selection corners (rebind in Controls); left/right-click with a stick also sets corners
autobuilder.help.list.detail: Built-in presets (yellow) and .litematic / .schem / .nbt files in the autobuild folder
autobuilder.help.load: Load a blueprint in front of you
autobuilder.help.load.detail: Placed 2 blocks in front of you, facing you. Press Tab to complete the name; the extension is optional
autobuilder.help.unload.detail: Also discards its saved progress; blocks already built stay
autobuilder.help.rotate.detail: Around the center of its bounding box
autobuilder.help.move.detail: Positive = east / up / south. Example: /ab move 0 -1 0 moves it down one block
autobuilder.help.origin: Move the origin to your feet
autobuilder.help.origin.detail: The origin is the bottom north-west corner; you can also give coordinates, e.g. /ab origin 100 64 -20
autobuilder.help.start.detail: Pressing a movement key pauses it so you can take over; press N or run it again to continue
autobuilder.help.stop.detail: The blueprint and progress are kept; you can resume after rejoining
autobuilder.help.status.detail: Progress, blocks to place / break, current activity
autobuilder.help.materials.detail: How much of each material is needed, how much is in your inventory and in supply chests, and how much is missing (supply chests count as last seen when opened)
autobuilder.help.replace.detail: Builds the blueprint with one block swapped for any other, e.g. a mob farm's iron blocks as cobblestone, or oak stairs as stone brick stairs (facing kept). With no arguments it opens the replace screen: pick a blueprint block on the left and what to use instead on the right (searchable). Or type /ab replace <block> <with>; air = leave that block out; only the first block undoes it; list prints the blocks in chat; clear undoes all. Replacements belong to the current blueprint and are remembered when you rejoin
autobuilder.replace.title: Material replacements (%s):
autobuilder.replace.blocks: Blocks in the blueprint (click to fill in the command):
autobuilder.replace.usage: Usage: /ab replace opens the replace screen; /ab replace <blueprint block> <new block>, air = don't build it; only the first block undoes it; /ab replace clear undoes all
autobuilder.replace.not_in_blueprint: The blueprint has no %s; type /ab replace to see which blocks it uses
autobuilder.replace.no_item: %s has no item, so it can't be built in survival
autobuilder.replace.set: %s replaced with %s (%s blocks), facing and other properties kept; the material list follows
autobuilder.help.pos.detail: Without coordinates it uses the block under your crosshair. The [ and ] keys do the same
autobuilder.help.save.detail: When built, its air cells get cleared. Water flowing in from outside the selection (lakes) is left out by default. Saved to the autobuild folder as .nbt
autobuilder.help.savesolid.detail: When built, existing blocks in its air cells are left alone
autobuilder.help.saveregion.detail: No selection needed, e.g. /ab saveregion 0 64 0 10 70 10 my_house
autobuilder.help.supplyadd.detail: Aim at a chest / barrel / shulker box. Saved per world and dimension
autobuilder.help.supplyremove.detail: Aim at the chest to remove
autobuilder.help.supplylist.detail: For the current world and dimension
autobuilder.help.supplyclear.detail: Only for the current world and dimension
autobuilder.help.menu.detail: Pick blueprints, position them, start building, save buildings
autobuilder.help.config.detail: Reach, place mode, scaffolding, auto-eat and more
autobuilder.cmd.loaded: Loaded %s (%s, %s blocks). Use /ab start to begin
autobuilder.cmd.status_progress: Progress %s%% (%s/%s)  place %s  break %s  adjust %s  wrong %s  unsupported %s
autobuilder.cmd.no_scan: No scan result yet (load a blueprint first)

autobuilder.cmd.not_container: Not a chest, barrel or shulker box: %s
autobuilder.cmd.saved_water: Left out %s blocks of water connected to the outside (lakes, rivers, sea, lily pads) and un-waterlogged %s blocks
autobuilder.cmd.saved_kept_water: Water inside the selection is kept: %s blocks will be placed with buckets (flowing water forms by itself)
autobuilder.configuration.reach.tooltip: Reach: max distance from your eyes to the nearest point of a block. Vanilla servers allow 4.5+1=5.5, so keep a margin
autobuilder.configuration.actionDelay.to: Ticks between actions (place / break / interact). 0 = every tick
autobuilder.configuration.placeMode.tool: AIRPLACE: place directly at the target cell, no supporting face needed. ADJACENT: click the face of a neighbouring block (more human-like; use it on servers with anti-cheat)
autobuilder.configuration.silentRotation: When placing directional blocks, only send rotation packets; your camera doesn't move
autobuilder.configuration.breakWrongBloc: Break wrong blocks at blueprint positions
autobuilder.configuration.clearAirBlocks: Break blocks where the blueprint has air (e.g. dirt inside a house)
Allow pillaring up and bridging with blocks
autobuilder.configuration.removeScaffold: Remove your own scaffolding when finished
autobuilder.configuration.scaffoldBlocks: Blocks that may be used as scaffolding
autobuilder.configuration.allowDig.toolt: Allow digging through terrain while pathfinding
autobuilder.configuration.autoEat.toolti: Eat food from your inventory when hungry
autobuilder.configuration.eatBelow.toolt: Eat when hunger is below this (full = 20)
autobuilder.configuration.stopBelowHealt: Stop building when health is below this (full = 20)
autobuilder.configuration.pauseOnInput.t: Pause when you press a movement key (to take over manually)
autobuilder.configuration.workSlots.tool: Hotbar slots (0-8) used when swapping items in from the inventory
autobuilder.configuration.renderGhosts.t: Render translucent blocks still to be placed
autobuilder.configuration.build.tooltip: Reach, speed, place mode, fixing wrong blocks
autobuilder.configuration.safety.tooltip: Auto-eat, low-health stop, pause on input, hotbar slots
autobuilder.configuration.drainWater.too: Fill water/lava sources where the blueprint has air with scaffold blocks (taken back once the spot is dry, the rest is removed with the scaffolding), and scoop water out of blocks that got waterlogged, using an empty bucket. Spots that outside water would flood again anyway are left alone
autobuilder.configuration.hideWhileBuild: Hide the translucent preview and boxes while building (it keeps working); shown again when paused. Press H to toggle any time
autobuilder.configuration.tools.tooltip: Selection wand, leaving out lake water when saving
Hold the wand item: left-click a block for corner 1, right-click for corner 2, up to 128 blocks away. The clicks don't break or use blocks
autobuilder.configuration.wandItem.toolt: Item ID used as the wand, e.g. minecraft:stick or minecraft:wooden_axe
autobuilder.configuration.dropOuterWater: When saving, leave out water that continues outside the selection (lakes, rivers, sea and lily pads on them); water enclosed inside, like a farm's water streams, is kept
autobuilder.msg.resting: Low health: stopping to eat and regenerate, will continue on its own
autobuilder.reason.low_health_hungry: health is low and there's no food to regenerate

autobuilder.wand.no_block: Not pointing at a block (max %s blocks)
autobuilder.cmd.wand_on: Selection wand on: hold %s, left-click a block for corner 1, right-click for corner 2
autobuilder.cmd.wand_off: Selection wand off (/ab wand on to enable), item: %s
autobuilder.help.wand.detail: Hold a stick in your main hand: left-click a block for corner 1, right-click for corner 2, up to 128 blocks away. Shift+right-click opens a menu for what you're looking at: make a chest a supply or dump chest, replace that blueprint block (works on preview blocks too), move/rotate the blueprint, start/pause, excavate or save the selection. Shift+left-click moves the blueprint to where you look, Shift+scroll nudges it one block along your facing (up/down when looking up or down). The item can be changed in the settings
autobuilder.help.hide.detail: Hides the translucent preview and boxes; building continues. Same as the H key
autobuilder.gather.chop_start: Chopping natural trees within %s blocks of here, nearest first
autobuilder.gather.chop_done: Done chopping: no more trees within %s blocks, chopped %s
autobuilder.gather.mine_start: Mining %s: %s-block main tunnel, %s-block side tunnels every 4 blocks, at y=%s. Only ores exposed by the tunnels are mined
autobuilder.gather.mine_done: Mining done: dug %s tunnel blocks, mined %s ores
autobuilder.gather.no_pickaxe: No usable pickaxe in the inventory (nearly broken ones are not used)
autobuilder.help.chop.detail: Chops natural trees around where you stand (24 blocks by default), nearest first, picks up the drops and replants saplings. Logs touching planks, glass, doors etc. are left alone so houses are safe
autobuilder.help.mine.detail: Digs 1×2 tunnels at your feet level in the direction you face (48-block main tunnel, 12-block side tunnels by default) and mines ores the tunnels expose, following veins. Never digs next to lava or water; throws away cobblestone etc. when the inventory is full
autobuilder.configuration.replantSapling: After chopping a single-trunk tree, plant a matching sapling if you have one
autobuilder.wand.hint: Wand: left/right = corners · Shift+right = menu · Shift+left = move blueprint · Shift+scroll = nudge
autobuilder.wand.supply_off: %s is no longer a supply chest
autobuilder.wand.dump_off: %s is no longer a dump chest

autobuilder.replace.grid_hint: Click a block to use it instead of %s (%s blocks; same shape first, numbers = in your inventory)

autobuilder.materials.click_replace: Click: replace this block with another
autobuilder.gather.kind_tip: Click for the next ore, Shift-click for the previous one
autobuilder.gather.chop_note: Natural trees around you; picks up drops and replants
autobuilder.gather.mine_note: At your feet level, towards where you face; mines exposed ores
autobuilder.gather.ore_note: Digs straight to ores in loaded chunks (check server rules first)
autobuilder.gather.dump_status: %s dump chests: gathered items go there when the inventory fills up (set them in Save / Supply)
autobuilder.configuration.diagnostics.to: Recording what it does, to track down problems
While building, chopping or mining, write every action and why things failed to autobuild/logs/, plus a snapshot when it looks stuck. Mark a problem with /ab log mark <note>
autobuilder.configuration.stuckSnapshotS: Write a snapshot when position and action haven't changed for this long
autobuilder.configuration.blockInflow.to: When water from outside (a lake, a stream, a nearby source) flows into the blueprint where it wants no water, block it with a block just outside the edge so the water inside can be drained. These blocks stay after the build (removing them lets the water back in)
autobuilder.log.no_file: Nothing written yet (a new file starts with each build or gathering job)
autobuilder.log.usage: When something goes wrong, type /ab log mark <note> to mark it in the log with a snapshot of the moment
autobuilder.log.marked: Marked in the log with a snapshot: %s
autobuilder.help.log.detail: Building, chopping and mining are logged to autobuild/logs/. When something goes wrong, /ab log mark <note> marks the moment and records a snapshot. /ab log shows where the files are; on/off switches it
autobuilder.msg.dam: Water from outside flows into the blueprint: blocking it with %s blocks just outside the edge (they stay after the build; removing them lets the water back in), then draining the inside
autobuilder.msg.extra_dam: ; left %s blocks outside the edge to hold back water
autobuilder.configuration.chopRadius.too: Radius /ab chop uses when you don't give one (blocks)
autobuilder.configuration.protectBuildin: Leave logs touching planks, glass, doors and other building blocks alone, so log houses are safe
autobuilder.configuration.oreRadius.tool: Radius /ab ore uses when you don't give one (blocks)
autobuilder.configuration.mineLength.too: Main tunnel length /ab mine uses when you don't give one
autobuilder.configuration.mineBranch.too: Side tunnel length /ab mine uses when you don't give one (0 = none)
autobuilder.configuration.excavateLayers: How many layers it digs at a time from the top. More is faster but leaves deeper holes around its feet
autobuilder.configuration.excavateKeepCo: Leave chests, barrels, furnaces, ender chests and other containers in place
autobuilder.configuration.maxExcavate.to: Largest selection allowed; a full scan of a huge one takes seconds
autobuilder.configuration.junkItems.tool: Items that may be thrown away when the inventory is full while chopping, mining or excavating (and no dump chest can take them)
autobuilder.configuration.keepScaffoldWh: Scaffold blocks kept when throwing junk away; without a dump chest, junk is only picked up while you have fewer than this
autobuilder.configuration.storage.toolti: Storing what it gathers in chests (/ab dump add)
autobuilder.configuration.depositWhenFre: While chopping, mining or excavating, go to a dump chest when fewer than this many inventory slots are free
autobuilder.configuration.depositAtEnd: Store when the job is done
autobuilder.configuration.depositAtEnd.t: When the whole job is done, store what it gathered in a dump chest
autobuilder.configuration.keepScaffoldWh: Scaffold blocks kept when storing (of the kind you have most of)
autobuilder.configuration.pickUpJunk: Pick up junk with a dump chest
autobuilder.configuration.pickUpJunk.too: With a dump chest, also pick up cobblestone, dirt and other junk so it gets stored
autobuilder.configuration.neverStore.too: Items never put into a dump chest (tools, armour, food, buckets and shulker boxes always stay with you)
autobuilder.configuration.ghostOpacity.t: Opacity of the translucent preview blocks (percent)
autobuilder.configuration.maxGhosts.tool: Max translucent blocks and outlines drawn; lower it if the preview makes the game lag
autobuilder.configuration.showBreakOutli: Outline the blocks that are going to be broken (red boxes)
autobuilder.configuration.showHud.toolti: Show the build state, progress and current action in the top-right corner
autobuilder.configuration.substituteWood: When a wood type runs out, use the same shape in another wood (oak planks for birch planks, spruce stairs for oak stairs...), sticking to one substitute per build. Blocks of another wood already in place count as correct
autobuilder.configuration.substituteColo: When a colour runs out, use another colour of the same block: beds, wool, carpet, concrete, stained glass and panes, terracotta, candles (plain glass, terracotta and candles count too)
autobuilder.configuration.searchNearbyCo: When materials run out, also open nearby chests, barrels and shulker boxes, not just registered supply chests, and take what's needed (nothing is put into them, trapped chests are left alone). On multiplayer this opens other players' chests too, so turn it off if that's not OK
autobuilder.configuration.searchRadius.t: How far from you to look for containers (blocks)
autobuilder.gather.ore_start: Ore hunting: %s blocks around, %s; digs to the nearest vein, then the next
autobuilder.gather.ore_done: Done: no more %2$s within %1$s blocks, mined %3$s
autobuilder.gather.ore_mp_note: Note: on multiplayer, check the server rules before using this; servers with anti-xray show fake ores or none
autobuilder.gather.ore_bad_kind: Unknown ore type, use one of: %s
autobuilder.help.ore.detail: Digs straight to ores in loaded chunks, one vein after another. Types: all diamond iron gold redstone lapis emerald coal copper debris quartz (default all, 32 blocks). Skips ores next to lava or water
autobuilder.gather.excavate_start: Excavating %s (%s×%s×%s): %s blocks to dig, top to bottom, layer by layer. Blocks next to water or lava are left alone
autobuilder.gather.excavate_containers: ; %s containers (chests etc.) in the selection are kept
autobuilder.gather.excavate_left: Excavation finished: %s blocks removed, %s left (next to water/lava or out of reach)
autobuilder.gather.excavate_empty: Nothing to dig in the selection
autobuilder.gather.excavate_unloaded: Part of the selection is in unloaded chunks; move closer and try again
autobuilder.gather.excavate_no_pickaxe: The selection has blocks that need a pickaxe (stone, ores...), but there's no usable pickaxe in your inventory
autobuilder.gather.excavate_need_sel: Set both corners first: left/right-click blocks with the selection wand, or use /ab pos1 and /ab pos2; or type /ab excavate <from> <to>
autobuilder.help.excavate.detail: Digs out every breakable block in the selection (or between two coordinates), two layers at a time from the top (configurable), working its way down without digging deep holes around its feet. Up to 1 million blocks by default. Containers and blocks next to water or lava are left alone; when the inventory fills up it drops cobblestone, dirt and other junk (keeping two stacks for scaffolding), or stores them in a dump chest if you have one
